c02_sen_left.text: Rahul Sen's professional profile shows he left Zentrix in 2019 — he could not have supervised Arjun until 2025.

c02_sen_praise.text: Rahul Sen calls him "the best engineer I've ever worked with".

c02_sen_conflict.text: Rahul Sen admits Arjun has been "consulting" for Sen's own firm since 2022: the reference is a business partner.

c02_forum.text: A security forum user "amalhotra" posts helpful Linux tutorials. Probably him; nothing alarming.

search.title: Zentrix confirms client data breach, cites insider access
search.snippet: The cloud provider said an account with elevated privileges exported client records over six weeks...
search.body: BENGALURU, April 2022. Zentrix Cloud Solutions has confirmed that records belonging to at least nine client tenants were exported over a six-week period using an internal account with elevated privileges. 'The individual is no longer with the company,' a spokesperson said. Zentrix declined to name the employee.
